[[Wreath of Worgen Blood]] | previous = [[Last of the Living Dead]] | next = [[The Evil Made Me Do It]] }} == Objectives == Bring 15 Gilnean Blood Vials and 15 Worgen Blood Vials to Orvan Darkeye in the Ruins of Grayshire. * [[Gilnean Blood Vial]] (15) * [[Worgen Blood Vial]] (15) == Description == I must say, you have proven to be a useful servant, and your mindless loyalty is a rare sight indeed in these times. But I must confess, I wasn't exactly truthful with you in the beginning. While my personal pursuit is the search for the works of Ur, I am also here on a mission from the Royal Apothecary Society. We believe that Gilneas is the perfect place to perfect our new weapon against the enemies of the Horde. But to do so, I require more blood. Human blood, and worgen blood. It's a delicate balance. Take these vials and head south of Stillward Church. There you will find Greymane's forces. It shouldn't be too difficult to get the blood we need from them. As for the worgen blood... well, they will come to you, one way or another. Just be ready for them when they do. ==Rewards== You will receive: * [[Sash of Innocent Blood]] and [[Wreath of Worgen Blood]] * 3980 XP == Progress == Be quick about it, my servant. == Completion == Now that is impressive. Let us see how this blood will react with my concoction. If my calculations are correct... ==Progression== {{Dead Until Dark}} ==Notes== ;Upon completion :The concoction explodes violently, covering Orvan in blood. :'''Orvan Darkeye says:''' Damn it! We will need the blasted book after all. ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.17.0|note=Added.}}
